statusDefinitions.reported: Documented historical learning activity, no current retest
statusDefinitions.milestone: A recorded specific past performance, not a general guarantee

skills.title: Sound Structure
skills.subtitle: Discover the pattern
skills.evidence: You identified the organized mora grid and developed a recoverable sound framework.
skills.detail: A key turning point: the kana stopped behaving like 46 unrelated items.

skills.title: Kana Recall
skills.subtitle: Retrieve unaided
skills.evidence: Memory-flash tests and scattered-tile reconstruction exposed slow and missed kana.
skills.detail: Retrieval, not recognition alone, became the central test.

skills.title: Written Production
skills.subtitle: Produce all base kana
skills.evidence: A reported next-day writing check reached 46/46 base hiragana. This is historical evidence, not a live mastery score.
skills.detail: Reconstruction progressed into independent written production.

skills.title: Connected Reading
skills.subtitle: Decode real expressions
skills.evidence: Current working focus: read connected kana and authentic Japanese material aloud.
skills.detail: Practice transfers the sound and letter system into actual passages.

skills.title: Musashi Application
skills.subtitle: Authentic Go Rin no Sho
skills.evidence: A proposed integration of vocabulary, grammar, and reading; no mastery certification claimed.
skills.detail: Use known kana as an entry point into authentic Musashi passages.

skills.title: Deliberate Practice
skills.subtitle: Choose a useful rep
skills.evidence: A cross-cutting skill emphasized by the Dojo pedagogy; not separately scored here.
skills.detail: Identify one useful bottleneck and initiate the next rep.
